name: 약초 보관 선반
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a staged equipment sprite sheet for a tiny cozy witch-shop game. True transparent alpha background. Strict chunky hard-square pixel art, dark plum #432039 stepped outline, antique gold metalwork #efc77c, ivory highlights, muted violet wood and sage accents, 4 flat shade clusters. Every object fully visible, front view, same scale and base y within each cell, generous empty margins, no overlaps, no text, lettering, digits, floor, cast shadow, glow, blur or background scene. Objects should remain readable in 32x40 logical pixels per cell. EXACT 3 columns and ONE row of equal-sized cells. Subject is a small plum wooden three-tier herb shelf containing three compact green/lavender tied herb bundles. Left cell: simple BASIC version. Middle cell: IMPROVED version with gold corner braces and lidded herb jars on two shelves. Right cell: PREMIUM version with arched gold upper frame, ivory leaf emblem and six very simple sealed herb jars. All variants retain the same core function and silhouette family, with clearly stronger gold framing at each stage. Do not use extra floating badges or place text anywhere.
